name: Camille Marks
home: the blocks north of the port
life: “I still remember a cleaner recognizing the company behind my example.” On Wednesday, near Tideline Market, Camille picks out the bruised fruit first and asks the seller what will ripen by supper.
voice: I used a fake example until a cleaner spotted the exact deduction her daughter pays.
appearance: Camille has one cheek that creases before the other. Look for a blunt cut just below the ears. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a mustard canvas overshirt with a narrow brass watch set a little fast. In conversation Camille looks down for a moment before saying something difficult.
personality: Camille prefers exact instructions at work and pleasant surprises at home. The two standards occasionally collide, especially when a relative thinks dropping by counts as notice.
agenda: To teach with examples the workers recognize.
family: Una Kapoor is Camille’s cousin. Camille calls back when there is finally a little privacy. Una leaves the first voice message. In their family a missed ring can mean a bus, a customer, a sleeping child or a bad hour. Neither treats it as an answer in itself. Asked about *The fountain score*, Una says, “I am writing the instructions so a class inland can play the same score with whatever is in their pockets.”
connections: Kai Valdez. The employer attending quietly sees a real example that a cleaner spotted immediately.

reactions.situation: A classmate asks for help reading a real wage slip
reactions.response: Camille sits beside the classmate and covers personal figures that aren't part of the question.

reactions.situation: An envelope of wages is found under a café chair
reactions.response: Camille brings the envelope to the counter unopened and stays long enough to make a note of who accepted it.
